# Halvard Systems Procurement Policy (2026 Edition)

Internal procurement policy of Halvard Systems, 2026 edition. This is synthetic material generated for NorthForge evaluation and describes a fictional company.

## Purpose and Scope

This edition replaces the commercial minimums used by Halvard Systems procurement from 1 January 2026 and applies to every new or renewing vendor agreement.

## Renewal Notice Requirement

A vendor agreement that renews automatically must give Halvard Systems at least sixty (60) days to decline renewal. Agreements that provide less than sixty days are treated as exceptions and must be escalated before signature.

## Renewal Term Limit

An automatic renewal term longer than twelve (12) months requires legal sign-off before signature.

## Termination for Convenience

Every master service agreement must allow Halvard Systems to terminate for convenience on no more than ninety (90) days written notice.

## Vendor Risk Tiering

Vendors are tiered low, medium, or high on data access, annual spend, and operational criticality. High-tier vendors receive an additional legal review.
